original_gate_and_scope_sections.text:
## Current owner result and audio/capture upgrade

Following the5.2 instructions, the owner reports a saved/playable local video and working live stream video, followed by **silent stream audio**. Exact installed versions, audio routes and media probes were not supplied; this is owner-reported partial success, not complete Deck/Kick acceptance. The earlier PulseAudio symlink warning remains an observed lead, not a proven diagnosis.

[Draft PR #34](https://github.com/szmyty/obsgod/pull/34), stacked on #33/#32, now implements the authorized audio/capture upgrade: bounded actual-monitor discovery, OBS-visible route/mixer verification, audio meters, entire-screen/game-only selection and a black/custom-message fallback during game changes. It also activates the bounded portion of #24/#23; #25 password controls remain deferred. Strict game capture must never silently use the compositor feed. Fresh exact-source native/package/device qualification remains required; older receipts do not qualify this newer source. Existing criteria below and missing CI/device/review gates remain open. No new merge, publication, deployment or issue closure.
